thread:
alex_sales: quick ask from EU bank POC — security needs three artifacts: 1) dataflow diagram showing EU-only residency and where data might transit; 2) explicit subprocessor roster + hosting regions; 3) statement on export controls / cross-border transfers (SCCs, KMS handling). can someone pull the latest pack?

marta_custsec: we have a POC artifact pack but the subproc list is a bit out of date. i can refresh it. do they want a network-level diagram or a logical/dataflow one?

sam_platform: logical + region mapping should satisfy vendor risk. we can produce a simple svg diagram. export-controls: we rely on SCCs for hosted API and offer Dedicated/Private to guarantee EU-only. for KMS: Private = customer KMS/HSM; Hosted = service-managed keys with envelope encryption and optional customer key wrapping.

irene_legal: quick question — did they ask about export control licensing (i.e., restrictions on moving data outside EU due to local law) or just the mechanisms (SCCs, SCC equivalents, contractual controls)? if it's licensing we need legal review and that adds time.

alex_sales: they marked "export controls" on the vendor risk form. sounds like they want to know if any data crosses borders (backups, metrics, logs) and what controls are in place. a concise yes/no + locations will do for now.

marta_custsec: :thumbsup: ok. current hosting: primary data in eu-west-1 / eu-central-1. backups and analytics indexes are retained in those regions by default. ops/telemetry may be replicated to other regions for incident response — need to be explicit about that. i'll confirm exact vendors.

sam_platform: hosted defaults: storage + compute in EU regions. metrics/telemetry retained in EU but we have SRE playbooks that may copy slices to us-west for active debugging on rare incidents. for Dedicated/Private we can contractually restrict all replicas to EU. i'll add a note we can enable customer-requested EU-only backup buckets.

marta_custsec: current subprocessors to call out: AWS (eu regions), Google Cloud Monitoring (eu-central host option), PagerDuty (global), Sentry (error telemetry), Mailgun (email notifications), stripe (billing, if relevant). are there any third-party ML inference libs that we should list?

sam_platform: inference runtime uses open-source libraries and third-party kernels (listed in our CAIQ), no external inference providers. also note our model artifacts are stored in eu buckets for this POC.

marta_custsec: customers also asked for KMS key lifecycle + least-privilege proof. we have a key-rotation policy doc and an HSM diagram. i can include a short snippet.

sam_platform: key rotation snippet for pack: `rotation_period: 90d; rotation_strategy: automatic; access_roles: [redwood-kms-admin, redwood-decrypt-service]` — include with controls mapping.

irene_legal: i can draft a short addendum clause: "data residency: provider will not transfer customer data outside EU without prior written consent; backups and debug artifacts will be stored in EU unless otherwise agreed." that will buy time while cs updates the pack.

marta_custsec: plan: i'll update subproc_list.csv, produce dataflow.svg (logical + region labels), attach kms-policy.pdf, and extract the SIG/CAIQ relevant control mappings. ETA: EOD tomorrow. tagging @alex_sales for handoff to customer.

alex_sales: perfect — please cc the customer when you upload. helps reduce follow-ups. thanks all.

deploy-bot: upload complete: https://storage.redwood.ai/packs/1957654321/poc-pack.zip
